title: Conditional residual second moment
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product space. The product expectation of $(f-E_Jf)^2$ equals the sum, over coordinate subsets $S$ not contained in $J$, of the product expectations of $f_S^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space with positive coordinate weights summing to one
$f$ is real-valued on the product space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $J\subseteq[n]$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_P(f-E_Jf)^2=\sum_{S\nsubseteq J}\mathbb E_Pf_S^2$.
